# Test fixtures

- **`complex_2fns.pdb`** — a 2-chain (A/B) interface subset of PDB entry **2fns**. Atomic
  coordinates from the RCSB Protein Data Bank are public-domain factual data. Used only as a
  real multi-chain structure to exercise interface extraction, cross-chain edges, the 172-dim
  node assembly, and the DSSP path. No upstream TopoQA code or feature output is used or embedded
  (this is a clean-room repo; there is no upstream feature oracle — see the top-level README).
